tests.description: All 34 downloaded audit source files match the recorded Git blob identities
Tape v1 preserves the complete normalized filter/sort state
Tape codec rejects unknown versions, extra keys and oversized input
Tape codec rejects unsupported premium and inferred-side labels
Unusual ranking retains negative absolute extremes and excludes null z
Top premium and explicit group/root filters preserve source population
Selectors do not mutate source order
Fresh means vol_gt_oi, not recency: aggregate only qualifying events
0DTE share denominator is all matching root premium
Current zero-denominator 0DTE screener share becomes 0; design requires unavailable
OI ranks absolute changes and does not pretend sector filtering is supported
Current ascending OI mid sort treats missing price like zero; design requires missing-last
Hot contracts retain source list order
Largest equal-premium/time rank is stable by source event ID
Board summary separates events, prints, contracts, roots and premium
Empty board has unknown call share, not a 0% claim
Current 0DTE board trusts flag even when fixture expiry differs; qualification must be separate
Exact validator preserves adjusted roots and supplied term distinctions
Impossible expiry, zero strike, whitespace root and malformed terms refuse
Duplicate same-list contract identity refuses pinning
A source session is required before pinning
Pin retains source stale flag and a frozen copied row
Shortlist max four refuses a fifth without rotation
Existing pin deduplicates and preserves original frozen pin
Hot by-volume and by-premium source lists share incumbent pin key; D08 must qualify sourceList semantics
Locate pin distinguishes filtered-away from absent; no row-index substitute
Display projector accepts incomplete/invalid identity and assumes100; never use as exact admission
Missing size/price remains NaN and quote/receipt stay unknown
Coverage retains unknown classification and excludes invalid premium
Tape and Screener have distinct30/38-column contracts
CSV hardens formula-like strings while preserving numeric negatives and null
Tape CSV preserves caller collection order and explicit source metadata
Observed counts with0%premium coverage remain valid and premium unknown
Valid observed-empty differs from absent/unobserved publisher
Statistics rejects broken count partitions
Statistics rejects wrong population and impossible date
Stats age and cached-fallback independently mark stale
Statistics does not turn unqualified premium into a zero subtotal
Statistics rejects unsafe counters and contradictory source totals
Closed futures parser accepts its existing valid integer cutoff
Futures rejects extra return keys, duplicate keys and proxy instruments
